On VTES-L, Lutek Kogutek wrote:
>
> Can I play reaction card(e.g. Deflection, Telepathic
> Misdirectoin or Enchenced Senses) after somebody increased
> his bleed action with action modifier like Threats or Aire
> of Elation?

You can react, yes. But you cannot attempt to block *if*
you've already declined to block. (And you cannot play
modifiers to increase your intercept unless you are attempting
to block.)
